routines.title: Daily Blog Publishing
routines.runbook: Select a new inclusive random target from 20 through 25. Research, draft, validate, run the official blader/humanizer skill, revalidate, render a deterministic 1200x630 thumbnail, update the existing app/data.ts content layer, run the build and structural checks, commit only the validated batch, push to coolifystealthagents/legalservicesoffshore main, record SHA/files/result, then stop. Never call Coolify or GSC.

routines.title: Daily Research Publishing
routines.runbook: Select a new inclusive random target from 10 through 15. Research with at least 10 real sources, draft, validate, run the official blader/humanizer skill, revalidate, render a deterministic 1200x630 thumbnail, update the existing app/fleet-data.ts research layer, run the build and structural checks, commit only the validated batch, push to coolifystealthagents/legalservicesoffshore main, record SHA/files/result, then stop. Never call Coolify or GSC.
